ISTI_GRAPEVINE_MILDEWS_2023_2026.title: Forewarning and development of inoculum based management strategies for grapevine mildews using spore trapping technology
ISTI_GRAPEVINE_MILDEWS_2023_2026.organization: India Science, Technology & Innovation Portal / TNAU
ISTI_GRAPEVINE_MILDEWS_2023_2026.reported_impact: Severe grapevine mildew conditions may cause approximately 50–100% yield loss.
ISTI_GRAPEVINE_MILDEWS_2023_2026.important_limitation: The reported range refers collectively to grapevine mildews and cannot be attributed independently to downy mildew or powdery mildew for an individual farm.

ONION_PURPLE_BLOTCH_TN_IPM.title: Integrated Pest and Disease Management Module for Shallots in Tamil Nadu
ONION_PURPLE_BLOTCH_TN_IPM.evidence_scope: Purple blotch impact under Tamil Nadu conditions
ONION_PURPLE_BLOTCH_TN_IPM.important_limitation: Contextual field literature value; not a severity-to-loss model for individual farms.

ONION_PURPLE_BLOTCH_SEED_LOSS_ICAR.title: Development of purple blotch incited by Alternaria porri and its losses in seed crop of onion
ONION_PURPLE_BLOTCH_SEED_LOSS_ICAR.evidence_scope: Onion seed crop under severe infection
ONION_PURPLE_BLOTCH_SEED_LOSS_ICAR.reported_impact: Severe infection caused major reductions in multiple seed-yield components, including very high seed yield reduction.
ONION_PURPLE_BLOTCH_SEED_LOSS_ICAR.important_limitation: Seed-production system; not directly transferable to commercial bulb-yield estimation.

ONION_STEMPHYLIUM_NASHIK_2014_IMPACT.title: Efficacy of fungicides alone and in combination with insecticides on foliar diseases of onion
ONION_STEMPHYLIUM_NASHIK_2014_IMPACT.reported_impact: Best management treatment increased marketable yield by 31.64% over untreated check while reducing Stemphylium blight.
ONION_STEMPHYLIUM_NASHIK_2014_IMPACT.important_limitation: Treatment benefit is not equivalent to a direct Stemphylium yield-loss percentage because combined fungicide/insecticide treatments were used.

ONION_STEMPHYLIUM_SEVERE_REVIEW.title: Recent Indian onion Stemphylium field literature
ONION_STEMPHYLIUM_SEVERE_REVIEW.reported_impact: Stemphylium leaf blight has been reported to cause very high yield and quality losses under severe favorable conditions, with values approaching approximately 90% in some reports.
ONION_STEMPHYLIUM_SEVERE_REVIEW.important_limitation: Represents severe-context literature, not a field-specific predictive relationship.

COTTON_ALTERNARIA_YIELD_LOSS_ANGRAU.title: Estimation of yield losses in cotton due to major fungal foliar diseases
COTTON_ALTERNARIA_YIELD_LOSS_ANGRAU.reported_impact: Seed cotton yield losses reported as 16.14%, 20.34%, and 26.28% across three evaluated genotypes.
COTTON_ALTERNARIA_YIELD_LOSS_ANGRAU.important_limitation: Genotype- and experiment-specific values; not an individual-field loss equation.

COTTON_BACTERIAL_BLIGHT_REVIEW_2024.title: Bacterial blight: Once a menacing disease of cotton in India, now tamed and fading from research spotlight
COTTON_BACTERIAL_BLIGHT_REVIEW_2024.reported_impact: Historical regular yield losses of about 30–35% were reported in India.
COTTON_BACTERIAL_BLIGHT_REVIEW_2024.important_limitation: Historical population-level impact; disease prevalence and cultivar resistance have changed.

COTTON_PINK_BOLLWORM_FIELD_LOSS_2025.title: Field estimates of current and predicted cotton yield loss due to pink bollworm and boll rot in India
COTTON_PINK_BOLLWORM_FIELD_LOSS_2025.reported_impact: Potential uncontrolled yield loss approximately 25%; estimated current annual loss under control conditions approximately 3.75%.
COTTON_PINK_BOLLWORM_FIELD_LOSS_2025.important_limitation: Applies specifically to pink bollworm (Pectinophora gossypiella). AgroSmart Model 1 currently predicts generic bollworm only.

TOMATO_EARLY_BLIGHT_YIELD_LOSS_2012.title: Assessment of Yield Loss Due to Early Blight (Alternaria solani) in Tomato
TOMATO_EARLY_BLIGHT_YIELD_LOSS_2012.reported_impact: Study developed a disease-severity/yield-loss relationship and reported substantial genotype-specific losses under protected versus unprotected conditions.
TOMATO_EARLY_BLIGHT_YIELD_LOSS_2012.important_limitation: Published relationship is experimental and location/genotype dependent; it requires validation before deployment as a farmer-specific loss equation.

TOMATO_LATE_BLIGHT_IIHR_2022.title: Tomato late blight yield loss assessment and risk aversion with resistant hybrid
TOMATO_LATE_BLIGHT_IIHR_2022.reported_impact: Average yield losses were 79.47% in NS501, 75.53% in Arka Rakshak, and 12.84% in resistant Arka Abhed.
TOMATO_LATE_BLIGHT_IIHR_2022.important_limitation: Strong genotype dependence prevents use of one universal late-blight loss percentage.

TOMATO_LEAF_MOLD_UCONN_2026.title: Tomato Leaf Mold
TOMATO_LEAF_MOLD_UCONN_2026.reported_impact: Leaf mold causes yellowing and can reduce overall yield, particularly under high-humidity protected cultivation.
TOMATO_LEAF_MOLD_UCONN_2026.important_limitation: No transferable quantitative yield-loss relationship provided.

TOMATO_LEAF_MOLD_CORNELL.title: Tomato Leaf Mold
TOMATO_LEAF_MOLD_CORNELL.reported_impact: Early disease may have limited effect on fruit production, but increasing severity can cause defoliation and greater production impact.
